description: This file contains the implementation of a Transformer-based neural network module, including classes for the Transformer model, encoder, decoder, encoder and decoder layers, along with helper functions for building and initializing the transformer. It appears to be part of a larger object detection project, specifically related to the DETR (Detection Transformer) architecture.

classes.name: Transformer
classes.description: Main Transformer class integrating encoder and decoder with customizable parameters for model configuration.

classes.name: TransformerEncoder
classes.description: Encoder stack consisting of multiple encoder layers with optional normalization.

classes.name: TransformerDecoder
classes.description: Decoder stack consisting of multiple decoder layers with optional normalization and intermediate outputs.

classes.name: TransformerEncoderLayer
classes.description: Single encoder layer implementing self-attention and feedforward network with normalization options.

classes.name: TransformerDecoderLayer
classes.description: Single decoder layer implementing self-attention, cross-attention, and feedforward network with normalization options.
